themes_detail.label: Street Condition Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street conditions complaints surged to 144 THIS WEEK—a 620% spike above the 8-week baseline of 20 complaints per week—suggesting a major deterioration event (pothole epidemic, flooding, or pavement failure) that may be tied to recent weather or infrastructure failure.
evidence: 144 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 20.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (620% increase, z-score: 24.09)
Highest z-score anomaly in dataset indicates most dramatic departure from baseline
Coincides with Snow/Ice complaints remaining elevated (947 over 90 days), suggesting weather-related deterioration
reporting_angles: On-the-ground inspection of major streets in Forest Hills and Rego Park to document specific hazards (potholes, flooding, pavement collapse)
Interview DOT and DCP about maintenance schedules and emergency response protocols; check if this is citywide or CD406-specific

themes_detail.label: Traffic Signal Failures Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic signal complaints jumped to 80 LAST WEEK—a 310% spike above the 8-week average of 19.5 per week—indicating widespread intersection hazards that pose safety risks to drivers and pedestrians.
evidence: 80 traffic signal complaints LAST WEEK vs. 19.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (310% increase, z-score: 7.46)
Aligns with elevated street condition complaints suggesting broader infrastructure degradation
Could be tied to weather events or utility work
reporting_angles: Map hotspot intersections in Forest Hills/Rego Park with malfunctioning signals; interview DOT about repair timelines
Document safety incidents (near-misses, accidents) at affected intersections through police reports or witness accounts

themes_detail.label: Maintenance & Facility Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance and facility complaints spiked to 13 THIS WEEK—a 512% jump from the 8-week baseline of 2.1 per week—suggesting rapid deterioration of public buildings, parks, or infrastructure facilities across the district.
evidence: 13 maintenance/facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (512% increase, z-score: 10.33)
Coincides with School Maintenance spike (8 complaints 2 weeks ago, 1500% above baseline), suggesting systemic facility issues
Aligns with community board's repeated budget requests for senior center renovation and park expansion
reporting_angles: Identify which facilities/buildings are generating complaints (schools, parks, senior centers); conduct facility inspections
Connect to long-standing CB budget requests for facility upgrades to assess whether chronic underfunding is culminating in failure

themes_detail.label: Damaged Trees & Environmental Stress
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints jumped to 36 TWO WEEKS AGO—a 747% spike above the 8-week average of 4.2 per week—paired with elevated graffiti (3 complaints THIS WEEK, 700% above baseline), suggesting environmental degradation and possible vandalism or storm damage.
evidence: 36 damaged tree complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 4.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (747% increase, z-score: 6.86)
Graffiti complaints also spiked to 3 THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 5.42)
Pattern suggests either severe weather event or organized vandalism; overlaps with street condition crisis
reporting_angles: Document tree damage across district parks and streets; interview Parks Department about cause (storm, disease, maintenance failure)
Investigate graffiti spike: is this random vandalism or organized? Interview NYPD and community members

themes_detail.label: Bus Stop Infrastructure Failures
themes_detail.summary: Bus stop shelter complaints jumped to 3 TWO WEEKS AGO—a 2300% spike from a baseline of 0.1 per week—indicating acute transit infrastructure failures affecting commuter access and safety.
evidence: 3 bus stop shelter complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% increase, z-score: 8.69)
Extremely rare complaint category with sudden emergence suggests targeted infrastructure failure
Affects daily commuters and transit-dependent populations
reporting_angles: Identify which bus stops in Forest Hills/Rego Park have damaged or missing shelters; photograph and document
Interview MTA about shelter maintenance schedules and repair response times
